lockedReason: {engine} is not available in this version yet, planned for later. The current engine stays selected.

toggles.label: Show or hide panels
toggles.lastOpen: Last visible panel, it cannot be hidden

resize.columns: Resize columns, use the arrow keys
resize.terminal: Resize terminal height, use the arrow keys

placeholder.stage: Nothing to show yet. Press Run after pasting SQL.
placeholder.terminal: The run log will appear here.

tip.layout: Choose which panels are visible. Your choice is remembered for next time.

engine.postgres: Runs PostgreSQL right in your browser, no sign-in needed.
engine.mysql: Runs real MySQL on a server, sign-in required.

tip.signIn: Sign in with Google or GitHub to use MySQL and the AI Mentor.
tip.account: Open the account menu, which has the sign-out button.
tip.sample: Fill the editor with a sample SQL so you can try it right away.
tip.run: Split the SQL into statements and run them one by one on PostgreSQL in your browser. Results show in the terminal and the simulation area.
tip.generate: Create fake rows for the tables you just made, to try with more data.

tab.schema: See the tables and foreign keys of the schema you just ran as a diagram.
tab.plan: See which steps the database takes for the SELECT and how many pages it reads.
tab.btree: See the real B-Tree of an index and drop a key to follow its path from root to leaf.
tab.whatif: Try adding or removing an index and compare pages read before and after, without changing real data.
tab.capacity: Drag the data size to see how the index grows taller and bigger.
tab.mentor: Ask the AI to explain the results. It only gets the plan and the SELECT, never table data.
tab.conflict: Pick a two-session conflict scenario and watch it tick by tick, including who waits for whom.

tip.drop: Drop this key into the tree to watch it go from root to leaf.
